status: prospective bounded proof-of-concept criteria; not flight acceptance
decision_authority: User chose bounded study and delegated provisional technical cutoffs; parent selected these before new Studio runs.
objective: Reduce repeated wind-map generation cost while preserving declared mean-flow outputs; report offline preparation separately from cached map-query cost.

resources.allowance: One documented cell-limit adjustment if geometric quality prevents the initial cap; stop and report failures instead of unlimited escalation.

targets.coverage: Report common-air and obstacle/wake-region errors separately, with fixed masks and valid/total counts; do not hide local errors in a large undisturbed domain average.
targets.measured_RMSE_gate_scope: Apply only where model/observation conditions are matched; it is not applicable to the new numerical-only Niigata ABL toy. Preserve original measurement mismatches explicitly.

integrity.reference: Numerically checked RANS reference, not physical truth
integrity.timing: Retime all compared recipes on Studio with identical quotas and stopping rules; retain Pro timings as historical and never infer cross-machine speedup.
integrity.forcing: Same force support in mesh comparisons; total-thrust normalization alone does not fix support aliasing.
integrity.physics: One global turbulence closure per joint fluid domain; assess any cross-scene closure transfer explicitly.
integrity.geometry: Retain full Niigata after-construction benchmark and SWiFT initially, with no default crop.
integrity.holdouts: Reserve whole conditions before method selection; current six SWiFT periods are exposed development evidence.
integrity.joint_closure: Select one compatible closure for both scenes from development comparisons; no per-obstacle mixture or independent wind-field addition.

niigata.reference_speed: 8.7 m/s at 32.1 m above flat ground; z0=0.01158 m, coherent neutral k/epsilon derived with the chosen closure and verified in an empty domain.
niigata.study_scope: Full source geometry scaled by 250 to full-size local metres; numerical-only neutral ABL optimization study, not a claim of matching original wind-tunnel observations.
niigata.historical_experiment: Retain original 1:250 N-wind baseline, 77/80 observation comparison, all errors and inlet drift. Do not compare the new ABL toy directly with those observations as matched validation.

swift_numerical.interpretation: Numerical generalization only; derive coherent neutral shear/k/epsilon from speed and roughness rather than varying incompatible turbulence inputs. Interpolate the locked v3 rotor curves consistently.

stopping: Close the bounded comparison when budgets expire or the tested non-dominated methods are established; explicitly report unmet targets. Joint remains empty until separate bounded comparisons close.
cluster_later: Scale condition population, geometry extent and fidelity one axis at a time; extra hardware does not resolve missing field evidence.
scope_revision_reason: Independent audit found the supplied wind-tunnel inflow remains under-specified and the shear-balance epsilon variant leaves about 40% near-ground k drift. Preserve experimental pilot as limited evidence; use a separately declared coherent neutral-ABL city toy for numerical cost reduction.

common_toy_closure.decision: Unfitted common numerical-POC model, selected from the existing SWiFT development improvement and matched empty-ABL check before new Studio trials.
common_toy_closure.limitation: This is not evidence of superior physical city accuracy. Optional standard-kEpsilon sensitivity remains separate; never mix closures by obstacle.

convergence.assessment: Declare a reference provisional if its frozen residual/flux/output checks fail. A cheaper stopping rule must still pass the common-ROI field-error targets against a checked reference. Report residual histories; do not relabel failed criteria as convergence.
convergence.iterations: Allow up to 2000 SIMPLE iterations only within the ten-minute solve cap; iteration numbers are not physical seconds.

city.horizontal_extent: full source footprint scaled by 250, approximately x/y +-200 m
city.comparison_frame: world local metres; rotate geometry/inflow/queries consistently and recompute each new direction

ROI.turbine: Use fixed matched-coordinate wake bins at 2-5D and a declared common wake volume; preserve original observation positions and masks.
ROI.broader_domain: Report separately so undisturbed cells cannot hide obstacle/wake error.
